en.title: Mass shooting reported in Birmingham, Alabama
en.dek: One person killed and eight others wounded in a mass shooting in Birmingham, Alabama.
facts: A mass shooting was reported in Birmingham, Alabama on November 13, 2026 by thestatetimes.com.
The report states one person was killed and eight others were wounded.
body: A mass shooting was reported in Birmingham, Alabama. The report from thestatetimes.com states one person was killed and eight others were wounded.
No further details about the shooter, motive, or specific circumstances were included in the source material.
en.context: The source thestatetimes.com reported a mass shooting in Birmingham, Alabama with casualties, but provided no details on the shooter, motive, or time of the incident.

body: In Birmingham, Alabama, wurde eine Massenerschießung gemeldet. Der Bericht von statetimes.com besagt, dass eine Person getötet und acht weitere verletzt wurden.
Weitere Details zum Schützen, zum Motiv oder zu spezifischen Umständen wurden in dem Quellmaterial nicht enthalten.
